journey.name: contact import after leaving
journey.description:
A contact import keeps saving after you leave the import overview, and when it finishes it leaves you where you went instead of opening Pay Contacts. Saving the prepared follows without looking them up again is covered by journeys/contacts/import-all-contacts.xml and import-selected-contacts.xml.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring (package app.pubkyring) installed on the same device and signed with this repository's app/debug.keystore, as for the pubky ring choice rows journey, with an identity that follows many pubkys on pubky.app (62, as in import-all-contacts.xml), so the import takes long enough to leave. An onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default), PIN off and no active Pubky identity in Bitkit. The journey adopts that identity and saves its follows as contacts, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again. See README.md.
The import saves only to the device and can finish before Back is tapped; if Pay Contacts opens first, report "already imported" rather than failing.
Android differs from iOS only in identifiers. Every Ring row carries the same testTag, so tell the rows apart by their key caption, and the overview's profile and friend count carry no testTag, so read the "Import" title and the count from its "N friends" text; see the Identifiers table in journeys/README.md.

actions.action: Tap the header profile button (testTag "ProfileButton"); if the profile intro (testTag "ProfileIntro") shows, tap Continue (testTag "ProfileIntro-button")
Tap the Ring row (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity", told apart by its key caption) of the identity that follows many pubkys
Wait for the contact import overview (no testTag; titled "Import") and note the number of friends the summary (no testTag; "N friends") shows

Tap Import All (testTag "ContactImportOverviewImportAll") and straight away tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack"). If Pay Contacts (testTag "PayContactsContinue") shows instead, the import finished first: report "already imported" and stop
Wait ten seconds and verify Home still shows and Pay Contacts (testTag "PayContactsContinue") has not opened
Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu"), then Contacts (testTag "DrawerContacts"); if the contacts intro shows, tap its continue button
Verify Contacts lists one row (testTag "Contact_<pubky>") for each of the friends the overview counted
